signal: r4 Technologies launched r4 Public and named Mark Heinrich president to extend its Cross-Enterprise Management AI into government, projecting $100M-$200M revenue this year

email.body1:
Alan, saw r4 launched its Public division and is guiding to $100M to $200M in revenue this year as the Cross-Enterprise platform pushes into new verticals.

Growth that steep opens more accounts worth reaching than reps can personally cover, and good ones go cold while the team works the obvious fit. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for r4 off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Alan, quick follow-up for r4.

At that revenue ramp, expectations on pipeline climb faster than headcount can, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the number across commercial, public, and defense. The gap surfaces late, then the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings r4 needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Alan, last bit of proof for r4.

Memgraph, also an enterprise data and AI play, had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how r4's reply rate likely compares to peer enterprise-AI teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Alan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage across the new verticals without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A multi-division ramp is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise-AI motion? I will tailor it to r4 either way.
